hypothesis: The Request232 rank signal may contain a small economically positive tail, or may mainly improve win frequency while leaving severe downside large. Calibration-only tail decomposition can distinguish these cases before redesigning the target.
frozen: Request232 scores and event-time persistent-tradability labels
score_families: equal-weight percentile average of those two frozen scores
metrics: mean positive and mean non-positive outcome
forbidden: choosing a new threshold and claiming policy success
using future information as an input
next_if_positive_tail: Freeze the strongest predeclared tail family and test a risk-controlled entry/exit policy without threshold search.
next_if_downside_asymmetry: Separate upside opportunity from downside survivability and train a causal risk head.
next_if_no_tail_signal: Redesign the tradability target/representation because the current ranking is economically misaligned.
